query: WITH updated AS (UPDATE lane_parents SET deleted = TRUE WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id) INSERT INTO lane_parent_events (id, recorded_at, sequence, event_type, event, context) SELECT updated.id, COALESCE($2, NOW()), ROW_NUMBER() OVER () + $3, unnested.event_type, unnested.event, unnested.context FROM updated CROSS JOIN UNNEST($4::TEXT[], $5::JSONB[], $6::JSONB[]) AS unnested(event_type, event, context) RETURNING recorded_at
